## Contribution route

- Type: `docs | research | idea | new Blueprint | Blueprint contract | repository policy`
- Related issue: `not required | #<number>`
- Tracking issue or Pilot evidence: `not applicable | #<number>`

## Outcome

Describe the human-AI workflow problem resolved and the user-visible result.

## Contract and migration impact

- Required outcomes or invariants changed:
- Project adaptation freedom changed:
- Human authority or external-write boundary changed:
- Existing installations require migration:
- Path-scoped Blueprint revision changes:

Use `not applicable` for a non-normative contribution. If any contract field is substantive, link the required issue-first discussion.

## Public material

- Language policy followed:
- External sources and licenses checked:
- Private project and Pilot information removed:

## Checks

- [ ] This pull request follows one route in `CONTRIBUTING.md` and links every required issue.
- [ ] No installable Skill, runtime implementation, formal schema, generator, secret, or project-specific artifact was added.
- [ ] Changed local links and provenance examples were checked.
- [ ] User-visible changes were synchronized between `README.md` and `README.ko.md` when applicable.
- [ ] Blueprint contract changes preserve the path-scoped revision and single Installation Receipt standard.
- [ ] Generated capabilities and supporting assets remain project-local and global installation is prohibited.
- [ ] Pilot evidence, when present, uses the tracking issue and privacy-safe template rather than committed project artifacts.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] Label sync dry-run was used when label definitions changed.
